# SHIFT, Inc.

> SHIFT, Inc. is a Japan-based software quality assurance and business solutions company specializing in testing, DevOps, and global business support services.

SHIFT, Inc. operates as a leading QA and software development services provider with international expansion, including a U.S. subsidiary in Silicon Valley. The company actively pursues strategic acquisitions and partnerships to enhance its service offerings and global presence.

- [Establishment of a Subsidiary in the U.S.](https://en.shiftinc.jp/news_en/establishment-of-a-subsidiary-in-the-u-s/): Announcement of SHIFT's U.S. subsidiary establishment and Silicon Valley expansion.
- [SNC Acquired Four Certifications, including R2 ver3](https://en.shiftinc.jp/news_en/r2ver3/): News on SNC Co., Ltd. acquiring R2 ver3 and ISO certifications for quality management.
